title: Network adaptability governs resilience and susceptibility to social defeat
title_zh: 网络适应性决定社会挫败的韧性与易感性
abstract: Abstract Stress resilience—the ability to maintain mental health after adversity—manifests in humans and rodents as efficient threat–safety discrimination and fear extinction. Although behavioral differences between resilient and susceptible individuals are well documented, the brain-wide structural signatures that distinguish resilience, susceptibility, and impaired threat learning remain poorly defined. Using a translational mouse model of chronic social defeat stress in male C57BL/6 J mice (n = 55), combined with preregistered multimodal magnetic resonance imaging with graph-theoretical analyses, we identify structural and network-level correlates of three behavioral phenotypes. Resilient animals exhibited greater microstructural complexity in prefrontal regions, and showed signatures consistent with enhanced inhibitory gating within amygdalar circuits. In contrast, susceptible animals—defined behaviorally by fear generalization and resistance to extinction—exhibited dentate gyrus alterations across all measures, suggesting diminished microstructural adaptability. A third phenotype, impaired threat learning—mice that failed to avoid individuals from a threatening strain—was associated with altered CA1/CA2 microstructure and reduced structural connectivity in pons, pointing to disrupted hippocampal–brainstem interactions during memory consolidation. These findings demonstrate that resilience, susceptibility, and impaired threat learning arise from dissociable patterns of brain organization, with resilience reflecting adaptive circuit-level organization and susceptibility and impaired threat learning exhibiting distinct forms of microstructural and network reorganization.
abstract_zh: 摘要：压力韧性——在逆境后保持心理健康的能力——在人类和啮齿动物中表现为高效的威胁-安全辨别和恐惧消退。虽然韧性个体与易感个体在行为上的差异已被充分记录，但区分韧性、易感性和受损威胁学习的全脑结构特征仍不清晰。我们在雄性C57BL/6 J小鼠（n = 55）中使用慢性社会挫败压力的可转化模型，并结合预注册的多模态磁共振成像与图论分析，识别了三种行为表型的结构和网络层面相关性。韧性动物在前额叶区域表现出更高的微结构复杂度，并显示出与杏仁核回路内抑制门控增强一致的特征。相反，易感动物——在行为上以恐惧泛化和对消退的抵抗为特征——在齿状回各项测量中均出现改变，提示微结构适应性下降。第三种表型为受损威胁学习——未能避免来自威胁株个体的老鼠——与CA1/CA2微结构改变和延髓结构连通性降低相关，提示在记忆巩固期间海马-脑干相互作用受损。这些发现表明，韧性、易感性和受损威胁学习源自可分离的大脑组织模式，韧性反映适应性回路级组织，而易感性和受损威胁学习表现出不同形式的微结构和网络重组。
